Patents

Patents and other forms of intellectual property protection play essential roles in encouraging innovation in biopharmaceuticals.
Today our company own 67 China National and International patents in cell culturing. As part of the “21st Century Cures” initiative, patent policy mechanism is designed to accelerate the discovery, development, and delivery of new treatments. Patent and intellectual property encourages innovation in biopharmaceutical research and development process.
